ops.title: PR269: check gitfile ownership before accepting discovery
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali <yasyf@poetic.com>. Next: validate ownership of regular .git files before reading them; decline so Git applies safe.directory when ownership differs. Evidence: internal/gitcmd/discover.go:59, internal/gitcmd/discover.go:102; https://github.com/git/git/blob/master/setup.c#L1472. Mixed-UID runtime fixture was not run.

ops.text: With worktree and target gitdir owned by the caller but a foreign-owned .git file, discovery declines and Dirs matches Git rejection or safe.directory approval.
